user.title: Set up AirPlay Notifier
user.description: Choose the player to speak announcements on, and the text-to-speech engine to use. Volume, language, and other behavior are configured afterwards from the options.

reconfigure.title: Change the player or engine
reconfigure.description: Point this AirPlay Notifier entry at a different player or text-to-speech engine. Its other settings, and the name of its notify service, are kept.

abort.already_configured: This media player is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: AirPlay Notifier now speaks on the player you chose.

error.unsupported_player: This media player does not support playing media, so it can never speak an announcement. Choose another one.

init.title: AirPlay Notifier settings
init.description: Tune how announcements are spoken on this player.

data_description.language: Leave empty to use the TTS engine's default language.
data_description.voice: Engine-specific voice identifier. Leave empty to use the engine's default voice.
data_description.restore_volume: Restore the player's previous volume once the announcement has finished. Not applicable to the Music Assistant strategy, which manages announcement volume itself.
data_description.strategy: Auto detects Music Assistant players automatically; Music Assistant and Direct force one delivery path.
data_description.announce_prefix: Text spoken before every message, e.g. a chime word or "Attention".
data_description.deny_domains: Comma-separated entity domains. A call whose data.source_entity belongs to one of these is refused and logged, never spoken.
data_description.quiet_start: Beginning of the window during which announcements are quietened or refused. Leave both times empty to disable quiet hours.
data_description.quiet_end: End of the window, excluded. Set it earlier than the start for a window that crosses midnight, such as 22:00 to 07:00.
data_description.quiet_volume: Volume to speak at during quiet hours. Leave empty to refuse announcements instead of speaking them quietly. A call with priority critical is spoken either way.

error.not_a_music_assistant_player: This player is not provided by Music Assistant, so the Music Assistant strategy cannot reach it. Use Auto or Direct.
error.quiet_hours_incomplete: Set both the start and the end of the quiet hours window, or leave both empty to disable it.

entry_not_loaded.message: The AirPlay Notifier entry behind this notify service is not loaded.

invalid_call_data.message: Refused to speak: the notification's 'data' payload is invalid ({error}).

invalid_source_entity.message: Refused to speak: 'source_entity' is "{source_entity}", which is not a usable entity id (expected domain.object_id), so the deny-list could not be checked.

no_delivery_path.message: Cannot speak: the target is a Music Assistant player but 'music_assistant.play_announcement' is unavailable, and 'tts.speak' is unavailable too.

source_domain_denied.message: Refused to speak on behalf of {source_entity}: the domain {domain} is in the denied source domains ({deny_domains}).

quiet_hours.message: Refused to speak on {player}: quiet hours are in effect ({start} to {end}) and no quiet hours volume is configured.

target_unavailable.message: AirPlay Notifier is not ready: {entities} does not exist yet.
